items.subject: Important info about Adina's Google Account
items.summary: Google confirms that a child account for Adina was added and explains its privacy, Family Link and parental-control arrangements.

items.subject: You created a new supervised account for Adina
items.summary: Google confirms creation of a supervised account for Adina, managed through Family Link and the Google family group.
items.action: Confirm that you intentionally created Adina’s supervised account. If not, open Google Family settings directly, remove the account and review recent Google Account activity.
items.decisionNeeded: Whether the new supervised account for Adina was authorised.

items.subject: Parent settings for Adina’s account
items.summary: Adina’s YouTube Kids profile uses the Younger setting, which limits searches to content recommended for children aged eight and under.

items.subject: Your Google Play Order Receipt from 13 Sept 2026
items.summary: A YouTube Premium Family subscription was purchased for £19.99 per month and is scheduled to renew automatically on 13 October 2026.
items.action: Confirm that you authorised the £19.99 monthly YouTube Premium Family subscription. If not, open Google Play directly to review the order and secure the associated Google Account.
items.decisionNeeded: Whether the new recurring YouTube Premium Family purchase was authorised.

items.subject: Your YouTube Premium family membership is good to go!
items.summary: YouTube confirms the same YouTube Premium Family subscription purchase and recurring billing reported in the Google Play receipt.

items.subject: Your new family group member
items.summary: HomeTV, using bakeshometv@gmail.com, accepted an invitation to Pete’s Google family group and can now access shared services, subscriptions and purchases.
items.action: Confirm that you invited and recognise HomeTV. If not, open Google Family settings directly, remove the unfamiliar member and review recent Google Account activity.
